corrected_text: Agello's DeviceProfile.defaultMaxTokens (a691212), the window a load requests, returns 65,536 tokens when physical memory is at least 11,000,000,000 bytes, else 16,384 when it is at least 7,000,000,000 bytes and 4,096 below that (per its comment, those two apply only to the iPhone app on a smaller Mac and to the simulator, iPhones having 12 GB, the app's floor since 2026-11-10); the iPhone 17 Pro's 12,291,735,552 bytes give 65,536, and with the published E4B file's export window of 32,003, ContextBudget.allocatedPositions (as LiteRT-LM does) makes that 32,000 positions. The window is not a setting; at 93122b647a the default was 8,192 tokens with at least 7,000,000,000 bytes of physical memory and 4,096 otherwise.

corrected_text: Agello's DeviceProfile.contextTokens(standard:roomBytes:) (a691212) lets a load take its default window unless the room left as it loads (MemoryProbe.roomBytes: the app limit, footprint + os_proc_available_memory(), minus the footprint, read by ChatEngine after the previous engine is unloaded) is below 5,100,000,000 bytes, which caps the window at 16,384 tokens, or below 3,500,000,000 bytes, which caps it at 8,192; with no limit reported (nil) it takes the default. Until the window stopped being a setting, DeviceProfile.maxContextTokens (93122b647a) capped the Settings range at 32,768 tokens with an app limit of at least 6,500,000,000 bytes and at 16,384 otherwise.
note: Re-verified at Agello HEAD a691212: DeviceProfile.maxContextTokens no longer exists (git grep), so the claim about the Settings ceiling is history. Its current counterpart: DeviceProfile.swift:118-123 contextTokens: nil room -> standard; room < roomForStandardContextBytes 3,500,000,000 (:113) -> min(standard, 8,192) (:106); room < roomForLargeContextBytes 5,100,000,000 (:103) -> min(standard, 16,384); else standard. Diagnostics.swift:64-68 roomBytes = limit - footprint (0 if over), nil without a limit; MemoryLimits.swift:12-16 limit = footprint + os_proc_available_memory() when available > 0. ChatEngine.swift:211-215 reads it after unloadAndRecord(). The 93122b647a source is kept for the history clause.
